axs15231.docs:
The `axs15231` touchscreen platform allows using the touch screen controllers based on the AXS15231 chip with ESPHome. An [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) bus is required to be set up in your configuration for this touchscreen to work.

*See also: [AXS15231 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/axs15231)*

cst9220.docs:
The `cst9220` touchscreen platform allows using touch screen controllers based on the Hynitron CST92xx series of chips with ESPHome. The component supports the CST9220 (multi-touch) and CST9217 (single-touch) controllers, which are found on a number of Waveshare ESP32-S3 Touch AMOLED displays. The [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) is required to be set up in your configuration for this touchscreen to work.

*See also: [cst9220 Touch Screen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/cst9220)*

*See also: [EKTF2232 Touchscreen Controller](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/ektf2232)*

sdl.docs:
The `sdl` touchscreen platform allows emulating a touch screen by using the mouse with the `sdl` display driver. The `sdl` display component must be configured to use this.

*See also: [SDL2 Touch Screen Emulator](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/sdl)*

xpt2046.docs:
The `xpt2046` touchscreen platform allows using the resistive touch screen controllers based on the XPT2046 chip ([datasheet](https://grobotronics.com/images/datasheets/xpt2046-datasheet.pdf), [AZ-Delivery](https://www.az-delivery.de/en/products/2-4-tft-lcd-touch-display)) with ESPHome. Many cheap LCD displays contain this controller. The [SPI](https://esphome.io/components/spi) is required to be set up in your configuration for this sensor to work.

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046)*

x_max.docs:
**int**: The raw value corresponding to the right

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

x_min.docs:
**int**: The raw value corresponding to the left

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

y_max.docs:
**int**: The raw value corresponding to the bottom

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

y_min.docs:
**int**: The raw value corresponding to the top

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

calibration.docs:
Some touchscreens require calibration on a per-device basis.

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

display.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The display to use this touchscreen with.

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

on_release.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the touchscreen is no longer touched. See [`on_release` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#touchscreen-on_release).

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

on_touch.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the touchscreen is touched. See [`on_touch` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#touchscreen-on_touch).

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

on_update.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the touchscreen is touched. See [`on_update` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#touchscreen-on_update).

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

touch_timeout.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: A timeout for touchscreens that do not report the end of touch. The default varies depending on the touchscreen.

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

mirror_x.docs:
**boolean**: If true, mirror the x axis.

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

mirror_y.docs:
**boolean**: If true, mirror the y axis.

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

swap_xy.docs:
**boolean**: If true, exchange the x and y axes.

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

transform.docs:
Transform the touchscreen presentation using hardware. All defaults are `false`.

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The touchscreen polling interval - used only if an interrupt pin is not in use. Defaults to `50ms`.

*See also: [Touchscreen Components](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen#configuration-variables)*
